name: creativedna-express-addon
description: CreativeDNA — AI campaign adaptation agent for Adobe Express (hackathon demo)

scripts.adobe:prepare: npm run build && rm -rf adobe-src && mkdir -p adobe-src && cp manifest.json adobe-src/ && cp -r dist/ui adobe-src/ui && mkdir -p adobe-src/sandbox && cp dist/sandbox/code.js adobe-src/sandbox/code.js
scripts.adobe:start: npm run adobe:prepare && node scripts/adobe-dev.mjs --src adobe-src --port 5241 --analytics off
